## PR acceptance checklist

This checklist encourages us to confirm any changes have been analyzed to reduce risks in quality, performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.

- [ ] Public options, rendered ARIA/data hooks, and host compatibility have been checked. Breaking changes include upgrade notes.
- [ ] Generated CSS and packaged files pass `bin/verify`.
- [ ] Relevant Ruby, JavaScript, and browser checks pass.
- [ ] Visible changes include light/dark evidence, keyboard behaviour, target sizes, and narrow layouts.
- [ ] Manual screen-reader evidence is recorded, or the missing checks are identified explicitly.
- [ ] The change follows the [Pathogen review checklist](https://github.com/phac-nml/pathogen-view-components/blob/main/docs/lookbook/design_system/05-review-checklist.md.erb).
